description: Change of use from dwelling (C3) to small HMO (C4) for 4 people with associated waste/refuse, car parking, cycle store and amenity space (Retrospective) (summary)
decision_conditions:
27. Various conditions have been suggested by the Council in the event the appeal is allowed. I have considered these against the tests set out in the Framework and Planning Practice Guidance, amending the wording where necessary to ensure precision and omitting others for the reasons set out below.
28. Given that there is dispute between the main parties with regards to whether or not the development has begun, I have imposed the standard time limit condition (1). I also impose a condition requiring the development to be carried out in accordance with the approved plans and documents (2) in the interests of certainty.

29. It would not be reasonable or necessary to impose a condition requiring the submission of a further HMO management plan (MP). This is because the proposed occupation of No 38 would be limited to four persons, the submitted MP broadly addresses the matters set out in the SPD, and many of these considerations would in any event be controlled through HMO licensing requirements. A separate condition to secure access to communal areas for all occupants would similarly be unnecessary. Moreover, it is not necessary to impose a condition limiting the number of residents to four, as this is already defined by the description of development, and any additional residents would require planning permission.
30. For the reasons set out in relation to the third main issue, it would not be reasonable or necessary to include a condition requiring the submission of a forecourt layout plan or the provision of cycle and refuse storage, as these arrangements already exist.
